sloka: एवं विभीषणस्यापि स्वर्गस्थस्येव नन्दने ।दशवर्षसहस्राणि गतानि नियतात्मनः ।। ७.१०.९ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ vibhīṣaṇasyāpi svargasthasyeva nandane ।daśavarṣasahasrāṇi gatāni niyatātmanaḥ ।। 7.10.9 ॥

translations.english: In this manner, ten thousand years passed for the self-controlled Vibhishana, as if he were residing in the Nandana garden of heaven.
